core_sidecar_payload.component: resources/core-sidecar (frozen PyInstaller onedir for the existing Python Core)

conclusion: UI-only installer passes (23.4 MB zip). Shipping the current frozen Core sidecar makes the package ~1.27 GB, so gate-10 as stated cannot pass without Core packaging work (drop PySide6/torch, split models into an on-demand download, or ship a slimmer Core build).
upgrade_path: Replace Spike.App.exe in place (single file); user data (Core data root) lives outside the app directory, so upgrade = atomic exe swap + version stamp + optional rollback. MSIX/Squirrel would add signing/auto-update; not needed to decide the architecture.
